note.overview: We use the guaranteed service (GS) framework to investigate how to coordinate a multiechelon supply chain when two self-interested parties control different parts of the supply chain. For purposes of supply chain planning, we assume that each stage in a supply chain operates with a local base-stock policy and can provide guaranteed service to its customers, as long as the customer demand falls within certain bounds. The GS framework for supply chain inventory optimization has been deployed successfully in multiple industrial contexts with centralized control.

models.name: Coordination of Multiechelon Supply Chains Using the Guaranteed Service Framework model
models.summary: We use the guaranteed service (GS) framework to investigate how to coordinate a multiechelon supply chain when two self-interested parties control different parts of the supply chain. For purposes of supply chain planning, we assume that each stage in a supply chain operates with a local base-stock policy and can provide guaranteed service to its customers, as long as the customer demand falls within certain bounds. This contract is incentive compatible and has several other desirable properties.
